implied specular sheen at cyan tip

self-lit bloom on near-black (no top-down light)
aurora vertical ramp (cool tip -> warm bulb)
rhymes_hint: dark-field single-luminous-object icons; holographic/iridescent-gradient (oil-slick, aurora) icons; glass/liquid blob-or-orb material icons glowing on near-black
notes: 204x204 WebP web render (masters at 1024) - specular micro-structure, refraction, and true Icon-Composer layer separation NOT verifiable, only inferred; corners baked opaque white (alpha=255 everywhere), squircle flattened onto white for web so real mask discipline unconfirmable, only that art sits inside the mask; hexes measured from render but low-res approximations. Era is an atmospheric/moody Liquid-Glass reading and could equally be logged custom (dark, bloomy, self-lit rather than crisp multi-layer specular). Subject communication is indirect: droplet = colour+liquid, not literally wallpaper; carried by the iridescence (=vibrant wallpapers) and the name pun. Tight palette coherence with cover (same cyan->magenta iridescent-on-dark vocabulary).
